g.text: Six anchor CSSVars + one --bg drive every swatch — edit any of them in DevTools to reflow the pipeline.
Chroma stays tied to the authored anchor — per-color manual tweaks (e.g., a red pullback) are out of scope for this schematic.
targets only — verdicts depend on live CSSVar values
